title: AN ACT relating to benefits for Kentucky National Guard members.
subject: Education, Higher
Military Affairs And Civil Defense
National Guard
Universities And Colleges

abstracts.abstract: Amend KRS 164.5161 to define "spouse"; rename the National Guard Tuition Award Program the National Guard Tuition Scholarship Program; allow current National Guard members and their spouses up to 130 total credit hours at a postsecondary institution; allow the total number of credit hours to be transferrable between the member and his or her spouse; grant authority to the adjutant general to award up to 45 additional nontransferable credit hours within the program; amend KRS 164.5165 and 164.5169 to conform.
